name: OneClickCloseAll
summary: A one-click utility Expert Advisor that closes all open positions and/or deletes all pending orders on the current account with a single button press on the chart. It provides a simple graphical button interface for traders to quickly liquidate all exposure in emergency or routine situations.
summary_zh: 这是一个一键平仓工具EA，通过图表上的按钮可以一键关闭所有持仓和/或删除所有挂单。为交易者提供简单的图形按钮界面，用于紧急或常规情况下快速清算所有头寸。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略型EA，而是一个账户管理工具。其核心功能是通过图表上的可视化按钮，一键执行关闭所有持仓订单和/或取消所有挂单的操作。入场条件不适用，因为它不开仓任何交易。出场条件方面，它会遍历账户中所有未平仓头寸并逐个平仓，同时可以选择性删除所有挂单。仓位管理和资金管理方面，该EA不涉及任何仓位计算或资金管理逻辑，仅负责批量平仓操作。风险控制方面，该工具本身不具备任何风控逻辑，但它作为风控辅助工具可以在市场剧烈波动时帮助交易者快速止损出场。整体而言，这是一个简洁实用的账户清仓工具，适合需要快速全仓平仓的场景使用。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but an account management utility. Its core function is to close all open positions and/or cancel all pending orders via a single button click on the chart. Entry conditions are not applicable since it does not open any trades. For exit conditions, it iterates through all open positions in the account and closes them one by one, with an optional feature to delete all pending orders. Position sizing and money management are not relevant as the EA does not calculate or manage any positions — it only handles batch closing operations. In terms of risk control, the utility itself has no risk management logic, but it serves as a risk management aid by allowing traders to quickly liquidate all exposure during extreme market volatility. Overall, it is a simple and practical account liquidation tool suitable for scenarios requiring rapid full-position closure.

parameters.name: CloseAllPositions
parameters.description: 是否关闭所有持仓订单

pros: 一键操作，紧急情况下可快速平仓，避免更大损失
界面简洁直观，操作门槛低，适合各类交易者使用
同时支持关闭持仓和删除挂单，功能覆盖全面
作为风控辅助工具，在市场黑天鹅事件中提供快速响应能力
pros_en: One-click operation allows rapid position closure in emergencies, preventing larger losses
Simple and intuitive interface with low learning curve, suitable for all types of traders
Supports both closing open positions and deleting pending orders, providing comprehensive coverage
Serves as a risk management aid offering quick response capability during black swan market events
cons: 缺乏确认对话框，误点击可能导致意外全部平仓
没有选择性平仓功能，无法按品种或方向筛选平仓
未实现平仓失败的重试机制和错误处理反馈
缺乏平仓进度显示和操作日志记录功能
cons_en: Lacks a confirmation dialog, so accidental clicks may cause unintended full liquidation
No selective closing feature — cannot filter positions by symbol or direction
No retry mechanism or error handling feedback for failed close operations
Missing progress display and operation logging for the closing process
improvements: 添加确认对话框防止误操作，并增加按品种/方向/盈亏筛选的选择性平仓功能
增加平仓失败重试机制、滑点保护、以及操作结果的详细日志记录
improvements_en: Add a confirmation dialog to prevent accidental execution, and implement selective closing by symbol/direction/profit-loss filtering
Add retry mechanism for failed close operations, slippage protection, and detailed operation logging

risk_points: 误点击可能导致全部头寸被意外平仓，缺乏二次确认机制
批量平仓时如果市场流动性不足可能产生较大滑点
risk_points_en: Accidental clicks may cause unintended full position liquidation due to lack of confirmation mechanism
Batch closing during low liquidity conditions may result in significant slippage

It provides a simple graphical button interface for traders to quickly liquidate all exposure in emergency or routine situations.
